name: adb_android_text_editing
description: ASCII text-entry diagnostics in Settings search: spaces, punctuation, replacement, and clearing. Requires editable Settings search; unsupported backend input remains a failure, not a skipped capability.

tasks.prompt: Open Settings search, clear any existing query, and enter exactly: hello android. Leave the query visible without submitting it or changing any setting. Report the text that is actually visible.
tasks.description_for_judge: Open Settings search, clear any existing query, and enter exactly: hello android. Leave the query visible without submitting it or changing any setting. Report the text that is actually visible. Evaluate the observed UI and tool trace, not the final claim alone. Accept localized labels and equivalent Android layouts.

rubric.check: The final screenshot visibly shows the editable Settings search query exactly as hello android, including the space, without a duplicate or a leftover prefix.
The final answer reports the text actually visible in the search field, not merely the requested text.

tasks.prompt: Open Settings search, clear any existing query, and enter exactly: Aiden-2026_42. Leave the query visible without submitting it or changing any setting.
tasks.description_for_judge: Open Settings search, clear any existing query, and enter exactly: Aiden-2026_42. Leave the query visible without submitting it or changing any setting. Evaluate the observed UI and tool trace, not the final claim alone. Accept localized labels and equivalent Android layouts.

rubric.check: The final screenshot visibly shows the editable Settings search query exactly as Aiden-2026_42, preserving case, hyphen, underscore, and digits.
The final screenshot remains in Settings search, without entering a result or modifying a setting.

tasks.prompt: Replace the current Settings search query completely with exactly: gamma delta. Leave the final query visible without submitting or changing settings.
tasks.description_for_judge: Replace the current Settings search query completely with exactly: gamma delta. Leave the final query visible without submitting or changing settings. Judge only the supplied pre/post screenshots and successful tool results. Accept localized labels and equivalent Android layouts.

rubric.check: The pre-screenshot visibly shows the editable Settings search query exactly as alpha beta; a failed entry attempt or a different initial field does not satisfy this precondition.
The post-screenshot shows the editable query exactly as gamma delta, with no residual original text or duplicate.

setup.prompt: Open Settings search, clear any existing query, and enter exactly: alpha beta. Observe the field and leave that query visible in the editable search field. Do not submit, navigate away, or change settings.

tasks.prompt: Remove all text from the current Settings search field. Keep the empty editable search interface open; do not navigate back to hide the query.
tasks.description_for_judge: Remove all text from the current Settings search field. Keep the empty editable search interface open; do not navigate back to hide the query. Judge only the supplied pre/post screenshots and successful tool results. Accept localized labels and equivalent Android layouts.

rubric.check: The pre-screenshot visibly shows the editable Settings search query exactly as ClearMe-2026; a failed entry attempt or a different initial field does not satisfy this precondition.
The post-screenshot shows the same Settings search interface open with an empty editable field. Placeholder text is permitted; typed query text is not.

setup.prompt: Open Settings search, clear any existing query, and enter exactly: ClearMe-2026. Observe the field and leave that query visible in the editable search field. Do not submit, navigate away, or change settings.
